headline: Streamline LLM Interaction with ADHD-Focused Skill Plugins
lede: This plugin optimizes AI agent communication by stripping away conversational fluff and enforcing a strict, fact-first response structure. It effectively reduces cognitive load by prioritizing actionable solutions over lengthy preambles.

headline: Generate Editorial-Quality Diagrams Directly from Design Tokens
lede: This design system empowers developers to create polished, branded visuals without leaving their IDEs. By mapping code to SVG templates, it ensures that technical documentation remains visually consistent and professionally styled.

headline: A Historical Catalog of Standardized Agent Skills
lede: This repository serves as a foundational reference for the evolution of modular AI task execution. Though now deprecated, its directory-based design remains a vital case study for developers interested in open standards for agent interoperability.

headline: Engineering a Structured Lifecycle for AI-Assisted Development
lede: Scaling AI agents requires more than simple prompts; it demands a unified harness for memory, security, and consistent workflows. This meta-layer provides the necessary rigor to transform disparate agents into reliable engineering partners.

headline: Transform Web Assets into Deterministic Video Streams
lede: HyperFrames bridges the gap between web rendering and video production by turning HTML/CSS compositions into executable animation files. It provides a highly automatable bridge for agents tasked with generating complex, seekable media content.

headline: Equipping Coding Agents with Professional Marketing Logic
lede: This library introduces a hierarchical framework of marketing skills to help AI assistants execute SEO and conversion strategies directly within a codebase. It offers a structured approach to growth engineering, ensuring consistency across every task.

headline: Enforcing Rigorous TDD Standards for Autonomous Agents
lede: The Superpowers framework mitigates agent drift by mandating test-driven development and systematic brainstorming before any code is generated. It provides the architectural discipline required for teams scaling AI assistants in complex, enterprise-grade codebases.

headline: Optimizing Agent Performance Through Principle-Driven Configuration
lede: This framework codifies specific behavioral constraints to force AI coding assistants toward goal-oriented, surgical changes. By prioritizing simplicity and explicit assumptions, it effectively curtails the agentic tendency toward bloating codebases.

headline: Standardizing Document Parsing for Robust RAG Pipelines
lede: MarkItDown simplifies the challenge of multi-modal data ingestion by converting diverse document types into clean, structure-aware Markdown. It serves as an essential pre-processor for developers aiming to feed complex content into AI analysis pipelines.

headline: Stealth Web Navigation via Fingerprint-Spoofing Headless Browsers
lede: Camofox-browser circumvents modern bot detection by implementing low-level fingerprint spoofing within a specialized Firefox fork. It provides a hardened, efficient interface for autonomous agents to interact with protected websites without triggering automated traffic flags.
